$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for this file.

appId.description: VK Mini App ID. Can also come from VKMA_APP_ID / MINI_APPS_APP_ID.

staticPath.description: Directory with the built app that gets zipped and uploaded, e.g. "./build".

bundle.description: Path to a prebuilt .zip archive. Skips zipping. Mutually exclusive with staticPath.

endpoints.description: Entry files per platform; at least one is required (VK does not process hosting tasks without endpoint_* parameters — the queue never delivers events). Only configured platforms are checked in preflight and sent; no defaults are injected.

mobile.description: Entry file for the mobile app (iOS & Android).

environment.description: Which hosting environment to deploy to. Default: "both".

updateProd.description: Switch production URLs to the new version. Default: true.

updateDev.description: Switch dev URLs to the new version. Default: true.

testGroupName.description: Deploy into a named test group instead of the common dev environment.

accessToken.description: VK access token. Prefer VKMA_ACCESS_TOKEN or `vkma-deploy login` over committing it.

apiVersion.description: VK API version. Default: "5.199". Set "5.131" for exact upstream compatibility.

oauthClientId.description: OAuth client used by the device flow.

queueTimeoutSec.description: Max seconds to wait for the hosting queue before failing.
